latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release.

- Upload images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, up to 200MB) and generate 1080p MP4 videos with transitions and background music, no editing required.
- Automatic cloud setup with free credits for new users; handles authentication and session management seamlessly.
- Provides export, credits, status, upload, and editing actions via simple prompts.
- Supports multiple file formats for input and export.
- Translates backend operations and handles errors with clear user messages.
- Guides users through common workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
